summary.text: Robert Wherry is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 13 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a chemical engineer who lives in Hudson, New Hampshire.

paragraphs.text: Robert Wherry lives in Hudson, New Hampshire, and, according to Ballotpedia, has worked as a chemical engineer.
He was elected to the Hudson Code of Ethics Committee.
Wherry has represented Hillsborough 13 since the 2022 election and was assigned to the Election Law Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
